title: 東京晴空塔
summary: 從三角形基底到圓形頂部的塔身斷面與格構風力出發，理解心柱與鋼塔之間以油壓阻尼器耦合的減振機制，計算直徑 2.3 m 鋼管與節狀壁樁的容量，再處理日照彎曲下的施工測量、在中央豎井內頂升天線塔、阻尼器的雙線性特性驗證、2011 年地震時施工中塔體的檢查，最後是冬季落冰與鋼管塔的防蝕維護。
summaryEn: Starting from the tower's triangle-to-circle section and the wind force on an open lattice, understand how the central column and steel tower are coupled through oil dampers to reduce vibration, compute the capacity of 2.3 m steel tubes and knuckle-wall piles, then handle construction surveys under solar bowing, lifting the antenna mast inside the central shaft, verifying bilinear damper behaviour, inspecting the unfinished tower after the 2011 earthquake, and finally falling ice and corrosion upkeep of a tubular steel tower.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力」與「心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice" and "Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「三角形到圓形的斷面」如何影響東京晴空塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Triangle-to-circle section” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tokyo Skytree”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 東京晴空塔底部是邊長約 68 m 的正三角形，三支腳柱向上逐漸收攏，斷面由三角形轉為圓形，約在 350 m 以上成為圓筒狀；高度與底寬比約 9：1，是極為細長的獨立塔。三角形基底在狹窄基地內提供最大的力臂與穩定性，圓形上部則讓不同風向的阻力較一致。塔身是鋼管桁架而非實心外牆，風力取決於桿件的投影面積與實積率，而不是整個輪廓面積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「三角形到圓形的斷面」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tokyo Skytree stands on an equilateral triangle with sides of about 68 m; its three legs draw together as they rise, so the section changes from a triangle to a circle and becomes cylindrical above about 350 m. Its height-to-base ratio is about 9 to 1, making it an extremely slender free-standing tower. The triangular base gives the largest lever arm and stability on a narrow site, while the circular upper section makes drag more uniform across wind directions. The body is a tubular steel truss rather than a solid skin, so wind force depends on member projected area and solidity ratio rather than on the whole outline. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Triangle-to-circle section” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：格構塔單位高度風力 F = q·C_f·φ·B。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Wind force per unit height on a lattice tower F = q·C_f·φ·B.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「格構塔透風，所以風力可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A lattice tower lets the wind through, so wind force can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「三角形到圓形的斷面」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Triangle-to-circle section”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力
knowledge.titleEn: Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice
knowledge.text: 東京晴空塔底部是邊長約 68 m 的正三角形，三支腳柱向上逐漸收攏，斷面由三角形轉為圓形，約在 350 m 以上成為圓筒狀；高度與底寬比約 9：1，是極為細長的獨立塔。三角形基底在狹窄基地內提供最大的力臂與穩定性，圓形上部則讓不同風向的阻力較一致。
knowledge.textEn: Tokyo Skytree stands on an equilateral triangle with sides of about 68 m; its three legs draw together as they rise, so the section changes from a triangle to a circle and becomes cylindrical above about 350 m. Its height-to-base ratio is about 9 to 1, making it an extremely slender free-standing tower.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：格構塔透風，所以風力可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A lattice tower lets the wind through, so wind force can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「東京晴空塔」的「三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「高樓模型整合室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice: mechanism and load path” in “Tokyo Skytree”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tower model integration room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice" is correct?
options: 格構塔透風，所以風力可以忽略。
東京晴空塔底部是邊長約 68 m 的正三角形，三支腳柱向上逐漸收攏，斷面由三角形轉為圓形，約在 350 m 以上成為圓筒狀。
心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。
optionsEn: A lattice tower lets the wind through, so wind force can be ignored.
Tokyo Skytree stands on an equilateral triangle with sides of about 68 m.
The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight.
quiz.explanation: 東京晴空塔底部是邊長約 68 m 的正三角形，三支腳柱向上逐漸收攏，斷面由三角形轉為圓形，約在 350 m 以上成為圓筒狀；高度與底寬比約 9：1，是極為細長的獨立塔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tokyo Skytree stands on an equilateral triangle with sides of about 68 m; its three legs draw together as they rise, so the section changes from a triangle to a circle and becomes cylindrical above about 350 m. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三角形到圓形的斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Triangle-to-circle section” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：格構塔單位高度風力 F = q·C_f·φ·B。風速 40 m/s 時 q = ½×1.225×40² ≈ 980 Pa；取 C_f = 2.0、實積率 φ = 0.25、外輪廓寬 B = 40 m，F = 980×2.0×0.25×40 ≈ 19.6 kN/m；若沿 600 m 均布，基底彎矩約 19.6×600²/2 ≈ 3.5 GN·m。細長比 634/68 ≈ 9.3。風速與係數為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Wind force per unit height on a lattice tower F = q·C_f·φ·B. At 40 m/s, q = ½×1.225×40² ≈ 980 Pa; with C_f = 2.0, solidity φ = 0.25 and outline width B = 40 m, F = 980×2.0×0.25×40 ≈ 19.6 kN/m, and spread over 600 m the base moment is about 19.6×600²/2 ≈ 3.5 GN·m. The slenderness is 634/68 ≈ 9.3. Wind speed and coefficients are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以風洞試驗量測不同高度斷面的阻力係數與實積率影響，並確認圓形段沒有明顯的渦流共振；分析模型要逐段輸入桿件投影面積，與風洞結果比較基底剪力與彎矩，並檢查天線、維修平台等附掛物增加的受風面積。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure drag coefficients and solidity effects for sections at different heights in the wind tunnel and confirm that the circular segment shows no marked vortex resonance; enter member projected areas segment by segment in the analysis model, compare base shear and moment with the wind-tunnel results, and account for added area from antennas and maintenance platforms.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 格構塔單位高度風力 F = q·C_f·φ·B。風速 40 m/s 時 q = ½×1.225×40² ≈ 980 Pa；取 C_f = 2.0、實積率 φ = 0.25、外輪廓寬 B = 40 m，F = 980×2.0×0.25×40 ≈ 19.6 kN/m；若沿 600 m 均布，基底彎矩約 19.6×600²/2 ≈ 3.5 GN·m。細長比 634/68 ≈ 9.3。風速與係數為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Wind force per unit height on a lattice tower F = q·C_f·φ·B. At 40 m/s, q = ½×1.225×40² ≈ 980 Pa; with C_f = 2.0, solidity φ = 0.25 and outline width B = 40 m, F = 980×2.0×0.25×40 ≈ 19.6 kN/m, and spread over 600 m the base moment is about 19.6×600²/2 ≈ 3.5 GN·m. The slenderness is 634/68 ≈ 9.3. Wind speed and coefficients are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice", which statement holds?
options: 塔很重，所以基礎只需要考慮下壓，不會受拉。
在豎井內頂升比較安全，所以不需要另做結構分析。
格構塔單位高度風力 F = q·C_f·φ·B。
optionsEn: The tower is heavy, so its foundation only needs to resist compression and never tension.
Lifting inside the shaft is safer, so no separate structural analysis is needed.
Wind force per unit height on a lattice tower F = q·C_f·φ·B.
quiz.explanation: 格構塔單位高度風力 F = q·C_f·φ·B。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Wind force per unit height on a lattice tower F = q·C_f·φ·B. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「三角形到圓形的斷面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Triangle-to-circle section” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以風洞試驗量測不同高度斷面的阻力係數與實積率影響，並確認圓形段沒有明顯的渦流共振；分析模型要逐段輸入桿件投影面積，與風洞結果比較基底剪力與彎矩，並檢查天線、維修平台等附掛物增加的受風面積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure drag coefficients and solidity effects for sections at different heights in the wind tunnel and confirm that the circular segment shows no marked vortex resonance; enter member projected areas segment by segment in the analysis model, compare base shear and moment with the wind-tunnel results, and account for added area from antennas and maintenance platforms. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立附掛物登錄制度：任何新增天線、燈具或設備都要登錄投影面積與重量，由結構工程師確認累計值仍在設計範圍內，才可安裝。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set up a register of attachments: every new antenna, light or device records its projected area and weight, and installation proceeds only after the structural engineer confirms the cumulative total is within design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若後續加裝天線、照明或廣告物而未重新計算受風面積，實積率上升會讓風力超出設計；圓形段若出現渦流共振，細長的上部會產生持續擺動，對天線與連接件造成疲勞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding antennas, lighting or signage later without recalculating wind area raises the solidity and pushes wind force beyond design; vortex resonance in the circular segment would make the slender top sway persistently, fatiguing antennas and connections. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以風洞試驗量測不同高度斷面的阻力係數與實積率影響，並確認圓形段沒有明顯的渦流共振；分析模型要逐段輸入桿件投影面積，與風洞結果比較基底剪力與彎矩，並檢查天線、維修平台等附掛物增加的受風面積。
knowledge.textEn: Measure drag coefficients and solidity effects for sections at different heights in the wind tunnel and confirm that the circular segment shows no marked vortex resonance; enter member projected areas segment by segment in the analysis model, compare base shear and moment with the wind-tunnel results, and account for added area from antennas and maintenance platforms.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立附掛物登錄制度：任何新增天線、燈具或設備都要登錄投影面積與重量，由結構工程師確認累計值仍在設計範圍內，才可安裝。
knowledge.textEn: Set up a register of attachments: every new antenna, light or device records its projected area and weight, and installation proceeds only after the structural engineer confirms the cumulative total is within design.

quiz.question: 要驗證「三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice"?
options: 以風洞試驗量測不同高度斷面的阻力係數與實積率影響，並確認圓形段沒有明顯的渦流共振。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
地震後只要外觀沒有明顯損壞，施工中的結構就可以立即復工。
optionsEn: Measure drag coefficients and solidity effects for sections at different heights in the wind tunnel and confirm that the circular segment shows no marked vortex resonance.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If there is no visible damage after an earthquake, work on an unfinished structure can resume immediately.
quiz.explanation: 以風洞試驗量測不同高度斷面的阻力係數與實積率影響，並確認圓形段沒有明顯的渦流共振；分析模型要逐段輸入桿件投影面積，與風洞結果比較基底剪力與彎矩，並檢查天線、維修平台等附掛物增加的受風面積。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure drag coefficients and solidity effects for sections at different heights in the wind tunnel and confirm that the circular segment shows no marked vortex resonance; enter member projected areas segment by segment in the analysis model, compare base shear and moment with the wind-tunnel results, and account for added area from antennas and maintenance platforms. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三角形到圓形的斷面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Triangle-to-circle section” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若後續加裝天線、照明或廣告物而未重新計算受風面積，實積率上升會讓風力超出設計；圓形段若出現渦流共振，細長的上部會產生持續擺動，對天線與連接件造成疲勞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding antennas, lighting or signage later without recalculating wind area raises the solidity and pushes wind force beyond design; vortex resonance in the circular segment would make the slender top sway persistently, fatiguing antennas and connections. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：塔身是鋼管桁架而非實心外牆，風力取決於桿件的投影面積與實積率，而不是整個輪廓面積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The body is a tubular steel truss rather than a solid skin, so wind force depends on member projected area and solidity ratio rather than on the whole outline.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「格構塔透風，所以風力可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lattice tower lets the wind through, so wind force can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若後續加裝天線、照明或廣告物而未重新計算受風面積，實積率上升會讓風力超出設計；圓形段若出現渦流共振，細長的上部會產生持續擺動，對天線與連接件造成疲勞。
knowledge.textEn: Adding antennas, lighting or signage later without recalculating wind area raises the solidity and pushes wind force beyond design; vortex resonance in the circular segment would make the slender top sway persistently, fatiguing antennas and connections.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「三角形基底、圓形頂部與格構風力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Triangular base, circular top and wind on a lattice" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若後續加裝天線、照明或廣告物而未重新計算受風面積，實積率上升會讓風力超出設計；圓形段若出現渦流共振，細長的上部會產生持續擺動，對天線與連接件造成疲勞。
心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adding antennas, lighting or signage later without recalculating wind area raises the solidity and pushes wind force beyond design.
The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight.
quiz.explanation: 若後續加裝天線、照明或廣告物而未重新計算受風面積，實積率上升會讓風力超出設計；圓形段若出現渦流共振，細長的上部會產生持續擺動，對天線與連接件造成疲勞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding antennas, lighting or signage later without recalculating wind area raises the solidity and pushes wind force beyond design; vortex resonance in the circular segment would make the slender top sway persistently, fatiguing antennas and connections. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「心柱制振」如何影響東京晴空塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shimbashira vibration control” governs force, deformation or durability in “Tokyo Skytree”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 塔的中央是一根直徑約 8 m 的鋼筋混凝土圓筒心柱，內設逃生樓梯，高度約到 375 m，與外側鋼塔在結構上分離。心柱在約 125 m 以下與鋼塔固結，125 m 至 375 m 之間則以油壓阻尼器連接；地震或強風時心柱與鋼塔的週期不同，擺動出現相位差，阻尼器在兩者的相對運動中消耗能量。設計概念取自五重塔的中心柱，公開資料稱可減少地震反應約 40% 至 50%。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「心柱制振」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At the centre stands a reinforced concrete cylinder about 8 m in diameter, housing an escape stair and rising to about 375 m, structurally separate from the outer steel tower. The column is fixed to the tower below about 125 m and connected by oil dampers between 125 m and 375 m; in an earthquake or strong wind the column and tower have different periods and sway out of phase, so the dampers dissipate energy in their relative motion. The concept is drawn from the central pillar of five-storey pagodas, and public sources state seismic response reductions of about 40% to 50%. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Shimbashira vibration control” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：阻尼器力 F = c·Δv，Δv = 2π·f·Δx。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Damper force F = c·Δv with Δv = 2π·f·Δx.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「心柱制振」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Shimbashira vibration control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The column is fixed to the tower below about 125 m and connected by oil dampers between 125 m and 375 m; in an earthquake or strong wind the column and tower have different periods and sway out of phase, so the dampers dissipate energy in their relative motion.

knowledge.text: 誤解：心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower" is correct?
options: 心柱是用來支撐鋼塔重量的主柱。
鋼管越粗越厚就越安全，接頭細節不重要。
塔的中央是一根直徑約 8 m 的鋼筋混凝土圓筒心柱，內設逃生樓梯，高度約到 375 m，與外側鋼塔在結構上分離。
optionsEn: The central column is the main column that carries the steel tower's weight.
The bigger and thicker the tube, the safer it is; joint details do not matter.
At the centre stands a reinforced concrete cylinder about 8 m in diameter, housing an escape stair and rising to about 375 m, structurally separate from the outer steel tower.
quiz.explanation: 塔的中央是一根直徑約 8 m 的鋼筋混凝土圓筒心柱，內設逃生樓梯，高度約到 375 m，與外側鋼塔在結構上分離。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At the centre stands a reinforced concrete cylinder about 8 m in diameter, housing an escape stair and rising to about 375 m, structurally separate from the outer steel tower. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「心柱制振」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shimbashira vibration control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：阻尼器力 F = c·Δv，Δv = 2π·f·Δx。若兩者相對位移振幅 Δx = 0.10 m、頻率 f = 0.3 Hz，Δv ≈ 0.188 m/s；阻尼係數 c = 5,000 kN·s/m 時 F ≈ 942 kN，每循環消耗能量 E = π·c·ω·Δx² ≈ π×5,000×1.885×0.01 ≈ 296 kJ。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Damper force F = c·Δv with Δv = 2π·f·Δx. For a relative amplitude Δx = 0.10 m at f = 0.3 Hz, Δv ≈ 0.188 m/s; with c = 5,000 kN·s/m, F ≈ 942 kN, and the energy dissipated per cycle is E = π·c·ω·Δx² ≈ π×5,000×1.885×0.01 ≈ 296 kJ. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器連接時的頂部加速度、基底剪力與兩者相對位移，確認相對位移落在阻尼器行程內；也要檢查心柱與鋼塔的週期比，若兩者太接近就不會產生足夠的相位差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare top acceleration, base shear and relative displacement with and without the damper connection in time-history analyses, confirming relative displacement stays within damper stroke; also check the period ratio of column and tower, since periods too close together will not produce enough phase difference.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 阻尼器力 F = c·Δv，Δv = 2π·f·Δx。若兩者相對位移振幅 Δx = 0.10 m、頻率 f = 0.3 Hz，Δv ≈ 0.188 m/s；阻尼係數 c = 5,000 kN·s/m 時 F ≈ 942 kN，每循環消耗能量 E = π·c·ω·Δx² ≈ π×5,000×1.885×0.01 ≈ 296 kJ。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Damper force F = c·Δv with Δv = 2π·f·Δx. For a relative amplitude Δx = 0.10 m at f = 0.3 Hz, Δv ≈ 0.188 m/s; with c = 5,000 kN·s/m, F ≈ 942 kN, and the energy dissipated per cycle is E = π·c·ω·Δx² ≈ π×5,000×1.885×0.01 ≈ 296 kJ. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器力 F = c·Δv，Δv = 2π·f·Δx。
鋼構安裝只要每段都對準設計座標，量測時間不重要。
阻尼器的力量越大越好，不需要限制。
optionsEn: Damper force F = c·Δv with Δv = 2π·f·Δx.
As long as each segment is set to design coordinates, the time of surveying does not matter.
The larger a damper's force the better, so it needs no limit.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器力 F = c·Δv，Δv = 2π·f·Δx。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Damper force F = c·Δv with Δv = 2π·f·Δx. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「心柱制振」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shimbashira vibration control” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器連接時的頂部加速度、基底剪力與兩者相對位移，確認相對位移落在阻尼器行程內；也要檢查心柱與鋼塔的週期比，若兩者太接近就不會產生足夠的相位差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare top acceleration, base shear and relative displacement with and without the damper connection in time-history analyses, confirming relative displacement stays within damper stroke; also check the period ratio of column and tower, since periods too close together will not produce enough phase difference. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：心柱與鋼塔的相對位移、阻尼器行程與淨空要在同一張圖上管理，任何在兩者之間新增的管線或平台都必須保留滑動或可撓接頭；阻尼器的型號、數量與試驗資料列入交接文件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Manage relative displacement, damper stroke and clearance between column and tower on one drawing, require any new services or platforms bridging the gap to keep sliding or flexible joints, and include damper models, numbers and test data in the handover documents.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若心柱與鋼塔之間的淨空不足，大地震時兩者可能碰撞；阻尼器若漏油或卡死，心柱會變成單純的附加質量或剛性連接，減振效果消失，甚至在某些頻率放大反應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient clearance between column and tower can let them collide in a major earthquake; if dampers leak or seize, the column becomes mere added mass or a rigid link, the damping benefit disappears and response may even amplify at some frequencies. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器連接時的頂部加速度、基底剪力與兩者相對位移，確認相對位移落在阻尼器行程內；也要檢查心柱與鋼塔的週期比，若兩者太接近就不會產生足夠的相位差。

quiz.question: 要驗證「心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower"?

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若心柱與鋼塔之間的淨空不足，大地震時兩者可能碰撞；阻尼器若漏油或卡死，心柱會變成單純的附加質量或剛性連接，減振效果消失，甚至在某些頻率放大反應。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient clearance between column and tower can let them collide in a major earthquake; if dampers leak or seize, the column becomes mere added mass or a rigid link, the damping benefit disappears and response may even amplify at some frequencies.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「心柱與鋼塔的相位差減振」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Out-of-phase damping between central column and tower" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼管越粗越厚就越安全，接頭細節不重要。
若心柱與鋼塔之間的淨空不足，大地震時兩者可能碰撞；阻尼器若漏油或卡死，心柱會變成單純的附加質量或剛性連接，減振效果消失，甚至在某些頻率放大反應。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The bigger and thicker the tube, the safer it is; joint details do not matter.
Insufficient clearance between column and tower can let them collide in a major earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 若心柱與鋼塔之間的淨空不足，大地震時兩者可能碰撞；阻尼器若漏油或卡死，心柱會變成單純的附加質量或剛性連接，減振效果消失，甚至在某些頻率放大反應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient clearance between column and tower can let them collide in a major earthquake; if dampers leak or seize, the column becomes mere added mass or a rigid link, the damping benefit disappears and response may even amplify at some frequencies.
